cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：证明；演示
cards.example_en: Let me demonstrate how to use this tool.
cards.example_zh: 让我演示如何使用这个工具。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：取决于；依靠
cards.example_en: Our picnic plans depend on clear weather this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我们的野餐安排取决于这个周末是否放晴。

cards.example_en: Describe your bedroom in five clear sentences.
cards.example_zh: 用五个清楚的句子描述一下你的卧室。

cards.example_en: A strong storm can destroy crops in the fields.
cards.example_zh: 强风暴可能会毁掉田里的庄稼。

cards.example_en: These plants die quickly without water in summer.
cards.example_zh: 这些植物在夏天缺水会很快枯死。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：分开；除
cards.example_en: Divide the cake into eight equal pieces.
The plate will drop if you hold it with one hand.
cards.example_zh: 如果你只用一只手拿，盘子就会掉下去。

cards.example_en: Edit your essay carefully before handing it in.
cards.example_zh: 交稿之前仔细修改你的文章。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：使能够
cards.example_en: This card will enable you to borrow library books.
cards.example_zh: 这张卡能让你借阅图书馆的书。

cards.example_en: Stay until the end, because the last scene explains the mystery.
cards.example_zh: 请一直看到结束，因为最后一场才揭开谜底。

cards.example_en: We enjoy hot soup on cold winter evenings.
cards.example_zh: 寒冷的冬夜，我们喜欢喝热汤。

cards.example_en: Ensure the front door is locked when you leave.
cards.example_zh: 离开的时候，一定要确认前门已经锁好。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：给……权利
cards.example_en: A student ticket will entitle you to a cheaper seat.
cards.example_zh: 持学生票可以买到更便宜的座位。

cards.example_en: The school will establish a new reading club.
cards.example_zh: 学校将成立一个新的阅读社团。

cards.example_en: The doctor will examine your sore throat today.
cards.example_zh: 医生今天会检查你疼痛的喉咙。
